key_points: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS missed consensus by ~17% and revenue missed, with the sixth straight revenue decline and weak advertising.
AI Cloud growth is strong (infra +94%, GPU cloud +191%) and AI-linked revenue reached 53% of general business, but margin pressure remains unresolved.
Multiple analyst price-target cuts and record-low shares reflect near-term de-rating on ad weakness and AI investment costs.
New U.S. restrictions on AI chip access add regulatory/geopolitical risk for Chinese tech and Baidu's AI ambitions.
Potential first dividend is a modest positive, but not enough to offset earnings miss and ad slump in the near term.
